description: Simple pendulum simulation with length 3 and small initial angle 0.3 radians, swinging for 2 seconds.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_physics import *

class PendulumSimple(SpaceScene):
    def construct(self):
        p = Pendulum(length=3, initial_theta=0.3)
        self.add(p)
        self.make_rigid_body(*p.bobs)
        p.start_swinging()
        self.wait(2)
